title: OpenMods mod manifest
description: A mod is an ordered series of git patches against a pinned commit of an open-source agent harness.

name.description: Mod id, unique within its harness. Lowercase, digits and hyphens.

harness.description: Id of a harness defined in harnesses/<id>.json.

ref.description: The harness release this mod supports, e.g. v1.18.31. This is the mod's version; CI moves it forward when the patches still apply and build on a newer release.

commit.description: The exact commit that ref pointed at.

patches.description: Applied in order with git am. Generate with git format-patch.

conflicts.description: Mods in the same harness known not to stack with this one.
